posts.text: India-US trade negotiations underway in New Delhi. Four-day round of talks aimed at an interim trade agreement. Our commitment to balanced, fair trade that benefits both nations remains unwavering.

posts.text: Bravo to the Indian contingent at the 22nd Asian U20 Athletics Championships 2026 held in Hong Kong. Your feat of winning 19 medals, including 10 golds, is the signature of India's unstoppable sporting prowess that will inspire legions of athletes across the nation.
posts.caption: Bravo to the Indian contingent at the 22nd Asian U20 Athletics Championships 2026 held in Hong Kong. Your feat of winning 19 medals, including 10 golds, is the signature of India's unstoppable sporting prowess that will inspire legions of athletes across the nation.

posts.text: The government is shielding Dharmendra Pradhan after the CBSE officials transfer. When will there be real accountability for our students? The PM took responsibility for the NEET retest — if there is another leak, we will demand answers at the highest level.
posts.caption: The government is shielding Dharmendra Pradhan after the CBSE officials transfer. When will there be real accountability for our students? The PM took responsibility for the NEET retest — if there is another leak, we will demand answers at the highest level.

posts.text: Uttar Pradesh continues to lead in development under double engine sarkar. Our state's youth are bringing glory at the national and international level. Every district is marching towards a Viksit UP.
posts.caption: Uttar Pradesh continues to lead in development under double engine sarkar. Our state's youth are bringing glory at the national and international level. Every district is marching towards a Viksit UP.

posts.text: The people of India deserve accountability from this government. From NEET to education to rising prices — the failures keep mounting. The INDIA alliance stands ready to fight for every citizen's rights.
posts.caption: The people of India deserve accountability from this government. From NEET to education to rising prices — the failures keep mounting. The INDIA alliance stands ready to fight for every citizen's rights.

posts.text: Good discussion with Minister-President Mario Voigt of Thuringia on expanding India-Germany business opportunities and technology partnerships. Also met South Africa's Deputy President Mashatile — strong commitment to deepening our longstanding partnership across trade, investments, MSMEs, digital and infrastructure domains.
posts.caption: Good discussion with Minister-President Mario Voigt of Thuringia on expanding India-Germany business opportunities and technology partnerships. posts.text: Record ₹12.2 lakh crore capital expenditure in Budget 2026 is accelerating India's infrastructure revolution. Structural reforms, productivity gains and technology adoption will continue to drive employment and economic expansion. Fiscal deficit narrowed to 4.3% of GDP — discipline with ambition.
posts.caption: Record ₹12.2 lakh crore capital expenditure in Budget 2026 is accelerating India's infrastructure revolution. posts.text: Met 17 of India's most compelling startup founders, most of them building at the frontiers of deep tech. It was inspiring, but more than that, it was a reminder. The next India will not be built in silos. It will be built at the intersection of founders, infrastructure, capital, energy, logistics, AI, space and talent. Founders build companies. Ecosystems build nations.

posts.text: Reliance is accelerating investments across energy, transport, logistics and digital infrastructure as part of our next phase of growth. Our AI Manifesto aims to transform Reliance into an AI-native deep-tech enterprise — targeting 10x productivity improvements. India's future cannot wait.
posts.caption: Reliance is accelerating investments across energy, transport, logistics and digital infrastructure as part of our next phase of growth. posts.text: I truly believe that the entrepreneurship ecosystem in India has evolved in a manner that can change the face of this nation. This is India's moment — let us build it together with integrity, compassion, and purpose.
posts.caption: I truly believe that the entrepreneurship ecosystem in India has evolved in a manner that can change the face of this nation. This is India's moment — let us build it together with integrity, compassion, and purpose.

posts.text: Warm greetings to the people of Telangana on the 12th Statehood Day. The vibrant culture, rich heritage and enterprising spirit of Telangana's people continue to make invaluable contributions to India's growth story.
posts.caption: Warm greetings to the people of Telangana on the 12th Statehood Day. The vibrant culture, rich heritage and enterprising spirit of Telangana's people continue to make invaluable contributions to India's growth story.

posts.text: The conversations between us have been going on continuously, including four days ago, three days ago, two days ago, one day ago and today. Where they lead, one never knows, but as I told Iran, 'It's time, one way or another, for you to make a Deal.'
posts.caption: The conversations between us have been going on continuously, including four days ago, three days ago, two days ago, one day ago and today. Where they lead, one never knows, but as I told Iran, 'It's time, one way or another, for you to make a Deal.'

posts.text: Britain's future depends on embracing technology and innovation. We must ensure the UK remains a global leader in AI while protecting the values that define us. Proud of what we built — the work continues from the backbenches.
posts.caption: Britain's future depends on embracing technology and innovation. We must ensure the UK remains a global leader in AI while protecting the values that define us. Proud of what we built — the work continues from the backbenches.

posts.text: The American Dream isn't dead — it's just been buried under bureaucracy. We need to cut the red tape, unleash innovation, and let entrepreneurs build freely. That's how we make America the greatest nation on earth again.
posts.caption: The American Dream isn't dead — it's just been buried under bureaucracy. We need to cut the red tape, unleash innovation, and let entrepreneurs build freely. That's how we make America the greatest nation on earth again.

posts.text: Honored to represent the United States at the Vatican. These diplomatic moments remind us that building bridges across cultures and faiths is essential to lasting peace.
posts.caption: Honored to represent the United States at the Vatican. These diplomatic moments remind us that building bridges across cultures and faiths is essential to lasting peace.

posts.text: Transparency and accountability are the pillars of a functioning democracy. We are rooting out corruption and restoring trust in our institutions. The American people deserve nothing less.
posts.caption: Transparency and accountability are the pillars of a functioning democracy. We are rooting out corruption and restoring trust in our institutions. The American people deserve nothing less.

posts.text: AI policy is about ensuring America leads the next wave of innovation. We're working to create frameworks that encourage responsible AI development while keeping the US at the frontier of technology.
posts.caption: AI policy is about ensuring America leads the next wave of innovation. We're working to create frameworks that encourage responsible AI development while keeping the US at the frontier of technology.

posts.text: At the World Bank, we are doubling down on climate finance and digital infrastructure for developing nations. No country should be left behind in the green transition or the digital revolution.
posts.caption: At the World Bank, we are doubling down on climate finance and digital infrastructure for developing nations. No country should be left behind in the green transition or the digital revolution.

posts.text: Our government is focused on growth, investment and opportunity for working people across Britain. The NHS, schools and public services — that's where we're putting our energy. Rebuilding Britain takes time, but we're making progress.
posts.caption: Our government is focused on growth, investment and opportunity for working people across Britain. The NHS, schools and public services — that's where we're putting our energy. Rebuilding Britain takes time, but we're making progress.

posts.text: Productive defence meetings with India in New Delhi today. Australia and India are strengthening military and strategic cooperation in the Indo-Pacific — a partnership that matters deeply to both our nations' security.
posts.caption: Productive defence meetings with India in New Delhi today. Australia and India are strengthening military and strategic cooperation in the Indo-Pacific — a partnership that matters deeply to both our nations' security.

posts.text: SoftBank's €75 billion AI investment in France is a testament to our nation's position at the forefront of the AI revolution. We are building the infrastructure for Europe's digital future right here. La France innovates.
posts.caption: SoftBank's €75 billion AI investment in France is a testament to our nation's position at the forefront of the AI revolution. We are building the infrastructure for Europe's digital future right here. La France innovates.

posts.text: The UAE continues to be a bridge between East and West. Our vision is clear: lead in AI, innovation, and sustainability. The future belongs to those who build it today.
posts.caption: The UAE continues to be a bridge between East and West. Our vision is clear: lead in AI, innovation, and sustainability. The future belongs to those who build it today.

posts.text: The Anthropic-SpaceX deal may be renewed at a lower price, the same price, a higher price or it may end. Don't believe everything you read — Bloomberg publishes bs.
posts.caption: The Anthropic-SpaceX deal may be renewed at a lower price, the same price, a higher price or it may end. Don't believe everything you read — Bloomberg publishes bs.

posts.text: Meta continues investing aggressively in AI infrastructure, agents, creator tools, and ecosystem integration. We're building AI that is fundamentally social — connecting people, not isolating them. The future of computing is about doing things together.
posts.caption: Meta continues investing aggressively in AI infrastructure, agents, creator tools, and ecosystem integration. We're building AI that is fundamentally social — connecting people, not isolating them. The future of computing is about doing things together.

posts.text: 2026 is the year of the supply crunch. We're managing a massive $180 billion CapEx budget at Google while pushing the boundaries of AI. Data centers in space, autonomous cars on the road — we're in a new era of discovery. AI is the biggest platform shift of our lifetimes.
posts.caption: 2026 is the year of the supply crunch. We're managing a massive $180 billion CapEx budget at Google while pushing the boundaries of AI. Data centers in space, autonomous cars on the road — we're in a new era of discovery. AI is the biggest platform shift of our lifetimes.

posts.text: There's a real platform shift. We're moving from building operating systems, devices for apps, to agents. The Surface RTX Spark Dev Box is a dream machine — I'm on the wait list myself. Project Solara is our vision for agent-first computing.
posts.caption: There's a real platform shift. We're moving from building operating systems, devices for apps, to agents. The Surface RTX Spark Dev Box is a dream machine — I'm on the wait list myself. Project Solara is our vision for agent-first computing.

posts.text: I think there is a race to deliver the best technology and build the best business, but going public is a financing event, and I don't think that's one that we're focused on the timing of. OpenAI will pursue an IPO when it makes sense for us.
posts.caption: I think there is a race to deliver the best technology and build the best business, but going public is a financing event, and I don't think that's one that we're focused on the timing of. OpenAI will pursue an IPO when it makes sense for us.

posts.text: WWDC is right around the corner. We can't wait to show developers what's next for Apple platforms. The most exciting innovations happen when world-class hardware meets world-class software. See you next week.
posts.caption: WWDC is right around the corner. We can't wait to show developers what's next for Apple platforms. The most exciting innovations happen when world-class hardware meets world-class software. See you next week.

posts.text: Useful AI has arrived. We're reinventing the PC with Microsoft — the RTX Spark is just the beginning. AI agents will be the biggest users of software going forward. Claims that AI will eliminate jobs are complete nonsense. Marvell could be the next trillion-dollar company.
posts.caption: Useful AI has arrived. We're reinventing the PC with Microsoft — the RTX Spark is just the beginning. AI agents will be the biggest users of software going forward. Claims that AI will eliminate jobs are complete nonsense. Marvell could be the next trillion-dollar company.

posts.text: India's digital public infrastructure — from Aadhaar to UPI to ONDC — continues to prove that technology built at population scale can transform economies. The next frontier is AI-powered governance and financial inclusion.
posts.caption: India's digital public infrastructure — from Aadhaar to UPI to ONDC — continues to prove that technology built at population scale can transform economies. The next frontier is AI-powered governance and financial inclusion.

posts.text: AI is going to be the most transformative technology of our lifetimes. But the real measure of success will be whether it reaches the people who need it most — in healthcare, education, and agriculture across the developing world.
posts.caption: AI is going to be the most transformative technology of our lifetimes. But the real measure of success will be whether it reaches the people who need it most — in healthcare, education, and agriculture across the developing world.

posts.text: Enterprise AI adoption is accelerating faster than any technology shift I've seen in my career. At IBM, we're focused on helping businesses deploy AI that's trustworthy, explainable, and delivers real ROI. The hybrid cloud + AI combination is where the value is.
posts.caption: Enterprise AI adoption is accelerating faster than any technology shift I've seen in my career. At IBM, we're focused on helping businesses deploy AI that's trustworthy, explainable, and delivers real ROI. The hybrid cloud + AI combination is where the value is.

posts.text: Creativity and AI are not opposites — they're partners. Adobe's generative AI tools are empowering millions of creators to do their best work faster. We're committed to building AI that respects creators' rights and fuels human imagination.
posts.caption: Creativity and AI are not opposites — they're partners. Adobe's generative AI tools are empowering millions of creators to do their best work faster. We're committed to building AI that respects creators' rights and fuels human imagination.

posts.text: Building great products requires deep technical conviction and the courage to make hard calls. Excited about the AI infrastructure opportunities ahead — the best is yet to come for those building at the frontier.
posts.caption: Building great products requires deep technical conviction and the courage to make hard calls. Excited about the AI infrastructure opportunities ahead — the best is yet to come for those building at the frontier.

posts.text: Luxury and technology are converging in extraordinary ways. At Chanel, we're embracing innovation while staying true to our heritage of craftsmanship. The future of fashion is where tradition meets the digital frontier.
posts.caption: Luxury and technology are converging in extraordinary ways. At Chanel, we're embracing innovation while staying true to our heritage of craftsmanship. The future of fashion is where tradition meets the digital frontier.

posts.text: At FedEx, we're using AI and data to transform global logistics. Our network moves 15 million packages a day — and AI is making every step smarter, faster, and more sustainable. The future of commerce depends on intelligent supply chains.
posts.caption: At FedEx, we're using AI and data to transform global logistics. Our network moves 15 million packages a day — and AI is making every step smarter, faster, and more sustainable. The future of commerce depends on intelligent supply chains.

posts.text: Come the big situation, you need the big guys to step up, and that's exactly what we did. Back-to-back champions! Now heading to the India camp — ODI series against Afghanistan starts June 13. The blue jersey calls.
posts.caption: Come the big situation, you need the big guys to step up, and that's exactly what we did. Back-to-back champions! Now heading to the India camp — ODI series against Afghanistan starts June 13. The blue jersey calls.

posts.text: Great to be at the T20 Mumbai League opener at Wankhede. Excited for the upcoming Test against Afghanistan and the England tour ahead. The red ball holds a special place — ready to lead the boys again.
posts.caption: Great to be at the T20 Mumbai League opener at Wankhede. Excited for the upcoming Test against Afghanistan and the England tour ahead. The red ball holds a special place — ready to lead the boys again.

posts.text: Cricket is a game of patience and moments. Watching the next generation carry the torch forward is the most rewarding part. Proud of every young player who steps onto the field with fire in their eyes.
posts.caption: Cricket is a game of patience and moments. Watching the next generation carry the torch forward is the most rewarding part. Proud of every young player who steps onto the field with fire in their eyes.

posts.text: Back to full pace and feeling good. Had to manage a niggle through the World Cup but now fully recovered. Focused on the England Test tour — 5 matches, big opportunity for the team. Ready to go.
posts.caption: Back to full pace and feeling good. Had to manage a niggle through the World Cup but now fully recovered. Focused on the England Test tour — 5 matches, big opportunity for the team. Ready to go.

posts.text: Reporting to the BCCI Centre of Excellence today for fitness clearance. Back spasms are behind me — ready to prove my fitness for the India vs Afghanistan ODI series. Nothing matters more than wearing the India jersey.
posts.caption: Reporting to the BCCI Centre of Excellence today for fitness clearance. Back spasms are behind me — ready to prove my fitness for the India vs Afghanistan ODI series. Nothing matters more than wearing the India jersey.

posts.text: What a season it has been! Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's record-breaking 776 runs at a strike rate of 237 is something special. At 15, the sky is the limit. Take it one match at a time and enjoy the journey, young man.
posts.caption: What a season it has been! Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's record-breaking 776 runs at a strike rate of 237 is something special. At 15, the sky is the limit. Take it one match at a time and enjoy the journey, young man.

posts.text: Indian cricket continues to produce extraordinary talent. From Sooryavanshi to the depth of our bowling attack — the future is incredibly bright. The upcoming England tour will be a true test of character.
posts.caption: Indian cricket continues to produce extraordinary talent. From Sooryavanshi to the depth of our bowling attack — the future is incredibly bright. The upcoming England tour will be a true test of character.

posts.text: India squad announced for the Afghanistan ODI series. Three matches in Dharamsala, Lucknow and Chennai starting June 13. Virat Kohli, Rohit Sharma, Hardik Pandya (subject to fitness) all named. Let's go, Team India! 🇮🇳
posts.caption: India squad announced for the Afghanistan ODI series. Three matches in Dharamsala, Lucknow and Chennai starting June 13. Virat Kohli, Rohit Sharma, Hardik Pandya (subject to fitness) all named. Let's go, Team India! 🇮🇳

posts.text: A busy June ahead for cricket! India vs Afghanistan Test and ODIs, Women's T20 World Cup kicking off, and England's home summer in full swing. The sport continues to grow globally. What match are you most looking forward to?

posts.text: What. A. Season. 🏆 RCB go back-to-back! Virat Kohli's unbeaten 75 in the final, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's record-breaking 776 runs at SR 237, and moments that will live forever. Thank you fans — see you in IPL 2027!

posts.text: Training hard for the Diamond League season. Every throw is a step closer to the 2028 LA Olympics. The goal remains the same — push my limits and make India proud on the biggest stage.
posts.caption: Training hard for the Diamond League season. Every throw is a step closer to the 2028 LA Olympics. The goal remains the same — push my limits and make India proud on the biggest stage.

posts.text: Back on the court and feeling strong. The road to LA 2028 is a marathon, not a sprint. Every tournament, every training session counts. Grateful for the support that keeps me going.
posts.caption: Back on the court and feeling strong. The road to LA 2028 is a marathon, not a sprint. Every tournament, every training session counts. Grateful for the support that keeps me going.

posts.text: Watching the next generation of Indian tennis players fills me with so much pride. The infrastructure and coaching landscape has changed dramatically. India's time in global tennis is coming — I truly believe that.
posts.caption: Watching the next generation of Indian tennis players fills me with so much pride. The infrastructure and coaching landscape has changed dramatically. India's time in global tennis is coming — I truly believe that.

posts.text: Preparing for the next big tournament. Every game of chess teaches you something new about yourself. Representing India on the world stage is the greatest honor. The journey continues.
posts.caption: Preparing for the next big tournament. Every game of chess teaches you something new about yourself. Representing India on the world stage is the greatest honor. The journey continues.

posts.text: Indian football is growing every single day. The grassroots programs are producing talent that can compete at the highest level. My message to every young footballer: dream big, work hard, and never give up.
